title: Civil Engineering Technology
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Civil Engineering Technology Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Upon successful completion of this program, students will be able to identify, formulate, and solve civil engineering technology problems by applying principles of mathematics, science, engineering, technology, and business to solve well-defined problems in civil engineering technology.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to evaluate the financial, legal, and ethical aspects of civil engineering projects.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply written, oral, and graphical communication in well-defined technical and non-technical environments.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to conduct standard tests, measurements, and experiments and to analyze and interpret the results.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to function effectively as a member of a technical team.
